entities.title: git_log and git_blame do not resolve paths
entities.summary: The path argument is passed to git after the root name is split off, without Root.Resolve.
entities.expected: A path outside the root is refused with outside_root, following macos/dotnet/style.md.
entities.observed: GitLogTool.Run and GitBlameTool.Run pass the relative path straight to git -C <root>; when the root is a subdirectory of its repository, ../ paths answer for files elsewhere in the repository, and other escapes surface as git_failed. zazzled always attaches the whole work tree and refuses paths outside it, so this matters only to other clients of the socket.
acceptanceCriteria: Both tools resolve their path through Root.Resolve, with a test.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder, by reading GitTools.cs against macos/dotnet/style.md; not reproduced.

entities.title: overview logs one file too few per root
entities.summary: OverviewTool adds each root's file count to CallInfo.TotalFiles, which starts at -1.
entities.expected: The usage log's files field for an overview call equals the number of files described.
entities.observed: It is the count minus one (for one root), because CallInfo.TotalFiles defaults to -1 and Describe adds to it.
acceptanceCriteria: The files field of an overview record equals the total number of files over the selected roots.
